blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines – As Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial enters its 39th day on Tuesday, October, 13, the impeachment court takes up administrative matters, specifically focusing on the handling of confidential documents included in the prosecution’s formal offer of evidence before going on a break.
